explanation: Erdős #1162 (Erdős–Turán): give an asymptotic formula for f(n), the number of subgroups of S_n. It is encoded as f ~ answer with an unknown answer; the vaguer second question is reasonably omitted. The best known result is log f(n) = (1/16 + o(1))n² (Roney-Dougal–Tracey), which falls short of an asymptotic for f itself. The statement is faithful and open.
